date.as_written: bāṇāṣṭamunibhir yukte gate pālavatsare | bhādramāsy asite pakṣe | aṣṭamyāṃ bhārgave dine || ... samvat 785 bhādrapadakṛṣṇe | aṣṭamyāṃ dine

notes: The scribe's name is read as Kutu (possibly Ketu) with a catalogue sic mark (!). The chronogram bāṇa (5) aṣṭa (8) muni (7) yields NS 785, confirmed by 'samvat 785'. 'pālavatsare' is likely an abbreviation/corruption for [ne]pālavatsare.
